# MCP tools: Search and memory

<!-- Generated by `sidekick.mcp.export_tool_reference` from `contracts/mcp-tools.generated.json`. Do not edit by hand. -->

[MCP tool reference](index.md) | 5 model-visible tools. The tools of this area that only the MCP App rooms call are on the [app-only page](app-only.md).

## `search`

Use this to find records by words when no id is known: searches the user's Tasks, Projects, Contacts and Journal (kinds narrows it).

Access: read

Scopes: requires at least one of `contacts:read`, `journal:read`, `projects:read`, `tasks:read`.

Returns: `SearchResult` with `searched` (array of string), `contacts` (ContactSearchPage or null), `journal` (JournalSearchPage or null), `projects` (ProjectSearchPage or null), `tasks` (TaskSearchPage or null).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query` | string | yes | 2 to 100 characters |
| `cursor` | string | no | up to 2048 characters; may be null |
| `kinds` | array of string | no | 1 to 4 items; items: `task`, `project`, `contact`, `journal`; may be null |
| `limit` | integer | no | default `10`; 1 to 25 |

## `recall_memory`

Use when the user asks what they know, said, felt or decided about a person, project, place or period, or when search finds nothing.

Access: read

Scopes: requires at least one of `contacts:read`, `journal:read`, `projects:read`, `tasks:read`.

Returns: `RecallMemoryResult` with `facts` (array of RecallFactRecord), `status` (string), `truncated` (boolean).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query` | string | yes | 2 to 300 characters |
| `kinds` | array of string | no | 1 to 4 items; items: `journal_entry`, `contact`, `project`, `task`; may be null |
| `limit` | integer | no | default `8`; 1 to 20 |

## `get_memory_status`

Use this when the user asks whether memory works or what it covers.

Access: read

Scopes: requires at least one of `contacts:read`, `journal:read`, `projects:read`, `tasks:read`.

Returns: `MemoryStatusResult` with `provider` (string), `settings` (MemorySettingsRecord), `sources` (array of MemorySourceCountRecord).

No parameters.

## `set_memory_settings`

Use this to turn memory on or off per domain (journal, contacts, projects, tasks) or to pause it.

Access: write (destructive)

Scopes: requires at least one of `contacts:write`, `journal:write`, `projects:write`, `tasks:write`.

Returns: `SetMemorySettingsResult` with `settings` (MemorySettingsRecord), `status` (string), `turning_off` (array of MemoryRemovalRecord).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `expected_version` | integer | yes | at least 0 |
| `confirm` | boolean | no | default `false` |
| `contacts` | boolean | no | may be null |
| `journal` | boolean | no | may be null |
| `paused` | boolean | no | may be null |
| `projects` | boolean | no | may be null |
| `tasks` | boolean | no | may be null |

## `exclude_from_memory`

Use this to keep one journal entry, contact, project or task out of memory, or back in with excluded=false.

Access: write

Scopes: requires at least one of `contacts:write`, `journal:write`, `projects:write`, `tasks:write`.

Returns: `ExcludeFromMemoryResult` with `changed` (boolean), `excluded` (boolean), `id` (uuid), `kind` (string).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | uuid | yes | - |
| `kind` | string | yes | one of `journal_entry`, `contact`, `project`, `task` |
| `excluded` | boolean | no | default `true` |
